speedNotes: Most games are decided on turns seven to nine. Two-drops matter but do not win alone; the best decks curve out and then cash in Kindle cards late.

mechanics.name: Kindle
mechanics.rulesText: Kindle N means "When this permanent enters, if you've cast another spell this turn, it deals N damage to any target."
mechanics.reminderText: (When this enters, if you've cast another spell this turn, it deals N damage to any target.)

mechanics.name: Tether
mechanics.rulesText: Tether is a keyword action. To tether a creature, tap it and put a tether counter on it. A creature with a tether counter doesn't untap during its controller's untap step. When it would untap, remove a tether counter from it instead.
mechanics.reminderText: (Tap it and put a tether counter on it. It doesn't untap while it has a tether counter; remove one instead.)

mechanics.name: Overgrow
mechanics.rulesText: Overgrow is an ability word. An ability with overgrow checks whether you control seven or more lands.

archetypes.name: Tether Control
archetypes.plan: Tether the opponent's best attackers, fly over the top with evasive two- and three-drops, and win the race in the air.

archetypes.name: Graveyard Tricksters
archetypes.plan: Fill the graveyard with self-mill and card draw, then reuse cheap creatures that come back from it.

archetypes.name: Sacrifice Aggro
archetypes.plan: Trade cheap creatures away for value, sacrifice them for damage, and close fast with Kindle burn.

archetypes.name: Big Kindle
archetypes.plan: Ramp into large Kindle creatures and cast a cheap spell first so each one enters with a burst of damage.

archetypes.name: Counters Go-Wide
archetypes.plan: Flood the board with small creatures, spread +1/+1 counters, and attack with everything.

archetypes.name: Lifedrain Midrange
archetypes.plan: Gain life with every creature that enters, then spend it on removal and drain effects.

archetypes.name: Spells Tempo
archetypes.plan: Cast two spells a turn: cheap cantrips turn on Kindle and prowess-style creatures.

archetypes.name: Overgrow Value
archetypes.plan: Ramp to seven lands with land recursion and finish with overgrow payoffs that are far above rate.

archetypes.name: Equipment Aggro
archetypes.plan: Curve out with two-drops, suit them up with cheap equipment, and push damage before blockers stabilize.

archetypes.name: Tether Ramp
archetypes.plan: Tether blockers to buy time while ramping, then win with large flyers and overgrow threats.

genericArchetypes.name: Five-color Overgrow
genericArchetypes.description: Play every fixing land and Mind Stone-style rock, take the strongest card in any color, and win the long game with overgrow bombs.

genericArchetypes.name: Mono-red Kindle
genericArchetypes.description: A deep red pool can run sixteen or seventeen red cards and burn the opponent out before overgrow matters.
